text:
diego: Heads-up: after yesterday's webhook replay to fix a missed batch, several refunds in Stripe show as applied but NetSuite import rejected them due to currency_code mismatch.
diego: Stripe webhooks: refund.created x46 (currency=USD) but NetSuite expects currency_code=USD (uppercase) and some payloads came through as 'usd' lowercased from legacy replay tool.
hannah: Oof. Which replay tool? That was the replay-worker-legacy we kept for back-compat. It lowercases JSON keys on resubmit.
dom: NetSuite importer log: "rejecting refund: currency_code invalid (expected ISO 4217)" for 46 records. netsuite-bot: ingestion: processed=912 skipped=46 reason=invalid_currency
billing-bot: replay: refunds.replay job=replay-2026-03-24-01 source=replay-worker-legacy count=46
sara: Finance: don't issue corrective entries yet. We need a CSV of affected refunds + amounts to understand AR impact.
diego: Quick fix: update replay-worker to preserve original key case OR normalize to uppercase for currency before sending. Also re-run a controlled replay with a transform.
hannah: I'll open a hotfix PR to fix key casing and add a schema validation step. Also adding unit test to ensure currency matches /[A-Z]{3}/.
dom: I'll reformat payloads and requeue only the 46 failed events to a safe replay queue with idempotency keys set. SQL to extract: SELECT id, invoice_id, amount, currency FROM stripe_refunds WHERE replay_job='replay-2026-03-24' AND processed=false;
sara: Please upload CSV to finance-drive so ops can reconcile before we re-import: drive.redwood.com/finance/replay_refunds_currency_mismatch_2026-03-24.csv
diego: Actions: 1) hannah: PR for replay-worker hotfix (ETA 30m); 2) dom: requeue transformed events to safe-queue (ETA 45m); 3) sara: hold ledger changes until import confirmed.
sara: Approved. Keep me posted before any NetSuite posting.
dom: Requeued 46 transformed events to safe-replay-queue. Will monitor importer.
netsuite-bot: ingestion: re-run dry-import processed=46 accepted=46
